note: R2-D: steps of setOption (the first at T0; a next one after the previous ran out, T + 10000, or `after` ms into it; notMerge unless `merge`), recorded at the last T + samples. Each element: an item path of a new series (id s<series>/<dataIndex>/<path>, the path its place in getPathList) or another path of its view (s<series>/x/<k>, owner the item whose group holds it); morph[i] = __morphT >= 0 and not combining, d[i] the replaced buildPath's PathProxy data (codes M1 L2 C3 Q4 A5 Z6 R7); comb[i] = __isCombineMorphing, pieces = its childrenRef() in order; style = the effective fill / stroke / lineWidth / opacity, snap = the path's transform and shape keys -- a key the same at every sample written once; text = the textContent's computed translation plus its style x / y, and its opacity. oldRest / newRest: every item path at rest before the last step and after it has run out (PathProxy data, computed transform). Every number is the hex of its double.
